newsitem.title: USA: APACHE QUADRUPLES HIGH ISLAND 195 GAS OUTPUT.
newsitem.headline: APACHE QUADRUPLES HIGH ISLAND 195 GAS OUTPUT.

text.p: Apache Corp has increased production from High Island Block 195 fourfold to 66 million cubic feet (MMcf) of natural gas per day, or 22 MMcf net to the company's interests.
The company said in a statement that the production increase resulted from the drilling of two additional Apache-operated gas wells, including a new pay discovery.
It expects to drill an offset well to the new discovery in the third quarter and bring it online before the end of this year.
Apache is the operator of the block and had a 40.7 percent interest.

Exxon Corp's Exxon Co USA unit has 33.3 percent, Edisto Exploration and Production Co has 23.5 percent, and Ridgewood Energy Equity Income has 2.5 percent. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
